name: age-verification-gate
title: Age verification gate
description: A gate for age-restricted shops: what the shop sells, a date of birth or a plain over-18 choice, and a calm way out for those who fail.
docs: mode 'birthdate' (the default) asks for a date of birth in three number fields in the order of locale (day, month, year in most of the world, month first for en-US, year first for ja-JP) with the autofill hints a browser knows. It refuses dates that do not exist (31 February, month 13), a year that is not four digits and a day in the future, and puts focus on the field that is wrong. mode 'confirm' is two buttons: 'I am 18 or older' and 'I am under 18'. minimumAge defaults to 18. onVerify(birthdate, remember) is called when the visitor passes: birthdate is yyyy-mm-dd (undefined in confirm mode) and remember is the checkbox you get with rememberLabel; remembering the visitor, with a cookie or otherwise, is yours. A visitor who is too young gets a calm message and a way out, not an error and never a dead end: pass onDecline (the button 'Leave this site') or leaveHref (the same, as a link that works without a script), at least one of them, and in birthdate mode 'Typed the wrong date? Try again' goes back to the fields. presentation 'dialog' (the default) is a named modal that cannot be dismissed with Escape or a click outside, keeps focus inside, leaves nothing behind it reachable and gives focus back to what had it before it opened; without open it stays until the visitor passes, or pass open to control it. It is drawn in the browser, so the HTML from the server does not contain it and the shop behind it is reachable until the page has loaded: use presentation 'page' for a gate that has to be in the HTML. presentation 'page' renders the gate as a whole page (a section named by its heading, which is an h2, or an h1 with headingAs when the gate is the page), and nothing when open is false. title says what the shop sells ('This shop sells alcohol'); brand, note and helpHref ('Why do we ask?') add the rest. defaultDeclined starts on the message for a visitor who has answered already, now and timeZone decide what today is, autoFocus can be turned off when the gate is one of several things on a page, and labels holds the fixed words.
